svg.title: One plugin can configure multiple MCP servers
svg.desc: An illustrative plugin-root mcp.json names a documentation server and an issue-tracking server. The host starts or connects to supported servers and exposes their tools to the active agent. Local or remote server execution is not a separate model context window. The actual CSV teaching fixture has no MCP servers.
